text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, I hear a knock on the
door of the training staff
office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, is what you said before still true?
Are
you still willing to support
me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-it's nothing too deep.
I just want to win. I
need to do this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much. Then, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So please. Can you help me win?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind... Please help me win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This next scrimmage is my last chance to
offer up a win to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus begins a fair few days of intense
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus begins a fair few days of intense
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She certainly has what it takes to be an
excellent runner, and her
improvement
day-to-day is tangible. Some worries
linger, however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh? But still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I felt like that was one of my
best too. But still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about not being able to
replicate these kinds of results in
front of a
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about not being able to
replicate these kinds of results in
front of a
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go for another. Please time
me again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having shared her thoughts, she takes off
once again. It seems like
mental
roadblocks are quite deep-rooted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her continue to give it her all, a
thought occurs to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even before I took over main training
duties, I've noticed one thing
about the
way she runs down the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, no, but isn't that normal? When I'm
running, I just want to focus
on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thinking too much about not
looking at the stands is causing
a break in
her overall concentration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Th-that's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What... do you want to try?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?! I-I can't do that... I'm just so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: B-but!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the scrimmage race finally
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Just look at all these people!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's undoubtedly due to the rumors of that
famous trainer's retirement.
There are
likely many trainers looking to scout
Dober themselves.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even though it is known that she still encounters some difficulties, she is still a Mejiro after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I guess so... Will she be okay, though?
She's been pushing herself way
too hard,
and I'm worried that she's going to get
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Ryan, I don't think you should
worry. She will definitely be
okay.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Right.
I can tell just by looking at her that
something is different
today.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text: Bell...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer...
She's definitely come to see me
today, right? I want to win.
I want to win! I
want to win for her today!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(But... It's all the same...
My heartbeat is
overwhelmingly loud...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... I looked... Right toward the
spectators...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Over there...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What're you yelling out... Dummy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She really... believes in me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's about to begin—
the final race in which
Mejiro Dober's chief
trainer can preside
over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's about to begin—
the final race in which
Mejiro Dober's chief
trainer can preside
over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clank!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(My heartbeat is still so loud...
I still don't
think I'm able to run
exactly like I do while
training.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I hate being the center of attention.
Their shouts, their cheers, the
very sense of their
presence... I don't want to look over at
those who are laughing at me...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still... Haaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(But still! There are some over there who
do truly believe in me!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm strong... I'm capable and strong!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm a strong Umamusumeee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
First place... Bell, that was a marvelous
race. I'm so happy for you,
and now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thank you very much for coming
today.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm the one who should be thanking you! I'm so happy to have been able to see you win. Now nothing lingers on my mind before I retire.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait,
that's a lie. There is one thing.
Bell, what do you plan to do
now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I plan to keep training with our assistant
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You won't say "no" after all this, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is that okay... with you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the retiring woman's good graces, I
complete the contract to
become Mejiro
Dober's new trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the retiring woman's good graces, I
complete the contract to
become Mejiro
Dober's new trainer.
